buyback_tx_visible_in_mempool.meaning: the buyback transaction is visible in the public mempool before execution

swap_succeeds.meaning: the V3 buyback swap completes successfully

olas_received_below_fair_value.meaning: protocol receives significantly less OLAS than fair value from the buyback swap (report gives no numeric fair-value amount; only the 99.99999999% loss bound)

effective_min_output_bound_enforced.meaning: the V3 buyback swap enforces an effective minimum output or price bound so execution at an arbitrarily inflated price is rejected

assumptions: The buyback swap is executed by the protocol against the Balancer V3 (Slipstream) pool for OLAS.
The attacker can front-run and back-run the visible buyback transaction in the pool.

unresolved.description: Report gives no concrete fair-value OLAS amount or actual received amount; only a qualitative 'significantly less than fair value' plus a 99.99999999% loss bound, so the value relation is carried by a grounded Boolean rather than a numeric comparison.

limitations: Impact is described as potential/conditional; no specific observed transaction or amounts are given.
The 99.99999999% loss bound is retained as a qualitative bound only; no numeric fair-value operand exists to form an exact comparison.
Only the impact_reduced_olas effect is formalized here; other impacts are handled in separate passes.
